armyRule.name: Martial Ka'tah
armyRule.text: Your units are readied at the start of your Command phase. A readied unit can use one Ka'tah below when its timing comes up. After using it, that unit is no longer readied:

katahs.name: Conservai
katahs.timing: Your Command phase - one readied unit.
katahs.text: Until the end of the turn, being engaged or battle-shocked doesn't stop it starting an action, and starting an action doesn't stop it shooting.

katahs.name: Calistus
katahs.timing: Your Movement phase, when a readied unit is selected to move.
katahs.text: On a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move, it can move through all types of model.

katahs.name: Salvus
katahs.timing: Your Shooting phase, when a readied unit is selected to shoot.
katahs.text: It ignores modifiers to its BS, Hit rolls and Wound rolls.

katahs.name: Dacatarai
katahs.timing: Start of the Fight phase - one readied unit.
katahs.text: Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for its melee attacks against non-Monster/Vehicle units.

katahs.name: Kaptaris
katahs.timing: Start of the Fight phase - one readied unit.
katahs.text: -1 to Hit rolls for melee attacks that target it.

katahs.name: Rendax
katahs.timing: Fight phase, when a readied unit is selected to fight.
katahs.text: Its melee attacks have Lethal Hits against Monster/Vehicle units.

keywordDefinitions.text: Your units become readied at the start of your Command phase. Using a Ka'tah means the unit is no longer readied.
Units with this ability have Feel No Pain 5+ against mortal wounds.
Gain 1 extra CP at the start of each battle round.
Feel No Pain 3+ against Psychic attacks. Also grants Psychic Null (aura): Adeptus Custodes units within 6" have Feel No Pain 5+ against Psychic attacks.
A unit is at Starting Strength if all models are still alive. Half-strength is if half or fewer of its starting models remain (or wounds, for a single model).
A unit is engaged while any of its models is within Engagement Range of an enemy model.
Critical Hit rolls score a bonus X Hits. These bonus Hits are not also critical.
Critical Hits can automatically wound (your choice). They can still be saved against.
+X Attacks for every 5 models in the target unit. All attacks with that profile must target the same unit.
Roll a D6 each time a model would lose a wound. If the result is X or greater, the wound is ignored.
Fights before units without this ability. The player whose turn it is picks first.
-1 to the BS of ranged attacks made against a unit that has it.
Each time an attack is made, the target can't have Benefit of Cover against that attack.
The unit always has Benefit of Cover against ranged attacks (it doesn't stack with cover from terrain).
Hit rolls do not need to be made by weapons with this ability; they automatically succeed.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets an Adeptus Custodes unit of yours.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Whenever a model in your unit is destroyed but your unit hasn't yet fought this phase, roll a D6, +1 if it is a Character. On a 3+, it isn't removed until your unit has fought or the phase ends.

rule.name: Companion's Watch
rule.text: While a Trusted Sentinel unit of yours is within range of an objective, re-roll Wound rolls of 1 for its attacks.

enhancements.name: Arae-shrike
enhancements.text: Infantry models only. Enemy units making an ingress move can't be set up within 12" of the bearer's unit.

enhancements.name: Celeritius Sentries
enhancements.text: Upgrade - Trusted Sentinel units only. Once per phase, this unit can be targeted with Heroic Intervention even if it was already used this phase. It costs 1 CP less and can still be used on other units.

stratagems.name: Emperor's Domain
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a Trusted Sentinel unit of yours is selected to Consolidate.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can use the objective consolidation mode regardless of its restrictions, even moving out of Engagement Range to do so.

stratagems.name: Avenge the Fallen
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when your unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: A Trusted Sentinel unit of yours that's below Starting Strength.
stratagems.effect: +2 to Attacks for your unit's melee attacks (not those made by Character models).

stratagems.name: Swift as the Eagle
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of your unit.
stratagems.target: An unengaged Trusted Sentinel unit of yours.
stratagems.effect: Your unit can make a Normal move of up to D3+3".

rule.name: On Gilded Wings
rule.text: At the end of your opponent's Fight phase, each unengaged Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit of yours can be placed into Strategic Reserves.

enhancements.name: Lightning Descent
enhancements.text: Shield-Captain in Allarus Terminator Armour only. The bearer's unit can make an ingress move in your first Movement phase.

enhancements.name: Leonine Ferocity
enhancements.text: Shield-Captain in Allarus Terminator Armour only. Once per phase, the bearer's unit can be targeted with Rapid Ingress even if it was already used this phase. It costs 1 CP less and can still be used on other units.

stratagems.name: Vigil Unending
stratagems.when: Your opponent's Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets your unit.
stratagems.target: That Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit of yours.
stratagems.effect: -1 to Damage for attacks targeting your unit until that enemy unit has attacked.

stratagems.name: Unleash the Lions
stratagems.when: Your Command phase.
stratagems.target: An Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit of yours with 2 or more models.
stratagems.effect: Split your unit into separate units of one model each. Each has a Starting Strength of 1.

stratagems.name: Fury of the Emperor
stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when your unit declares a charge.
stratagems.target: An Adeptus Custodes Terminator unit of yours that made an ingress move this turn.
stratagems.effect: +2 to Charge rolls for your unit.

rule.name: Moritoi Ancients
rule.text: +2 Objective Control for Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought units of yours at Starting Strength. Re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by your Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought units below Starting Strength. Re-roll Hit and Wound rolls of 1 for attacks made by your Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought units below Half-strength.

enhancements.name: Memento Moritoi
enhancements.text: Upgrade, one per army - Dreadnought models only. +1 to Attacks, Strength and Damage for the bearer's melee attacks.

enhancements.name: Augury Uplink
enhancements.text: Upgrade, one per army - Dreadnought models only. The bearer has Feel No Pain 5+.

stratagems.name: Honoured Interred
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase.
stratagems.target: An Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit of yours.
stratagems.effect: Your unit gains an aura: re-roll Hit rolls of 1 for Adeptus Custodes units within 6" of it.

stratagems.name: Unceasing Onslaught
stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when an Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit of yours ends an Advance move.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Until the end of the turn, your unit's ranged attacks have Assault and it can declare a charge.

stratagems.name: Unstoppable Momentum
stratagems.when: Your Movement or Charge phase, when your unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.target: An Adeptus Custodes Dreadnought unit of yours.
stratagems.effect: Your unit has the Mobile ability.

rule.name: Flare Shields
rule.text: Grav-Assault units of yours have a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

enhancements.name: Combat Deployment
enhancements.text: Upgrade - Grav-Assault Transport models only. When an Adeptus Custodes unit disembarks from this model, until the end of the turn it can re-roll Charge rolls and can't be targeted by snap shooting.

enhancements.name: Anti-Gravitic Mobility
enhancements.text: Upgrade - Grav-Assault units only. This unit can shoot the same turn it Falls Back.

stratagems.name: Victory Before Death
stratagems.when: Any phase, when a Grav-Assault unit of yours within range of an objective is destroyed.
stratagems.target: That unit.
stratagems.effect: Select one objective your unit was controlling that has no enemy units (except Aircraft) within range. That objective is secured.

stratagems.name: Advanced Stabilisers
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when your unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: A Grav-Assault unit of yours.
stratagems.effect: Your unit's ranged attacks have Assault.

stratagems.name: Inevitable Annihilation
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when your unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: A Grav-Assault unit of yours.
stratagems.effect: Your unit ignores modifiers to its BS and Hit rolls.

rule.name: Silent Sisterhood
rule.text: An Anathema Psykana Character can be your Warlord, and Prosecutor Squad units of yours have the Battleline keyword. Anathema Psykana units of yours gain Creeping Dread (aura):

extraRules.name: Creeping Dread (aura)
extraRules.text: In the battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, enemy Psyker units and enemy units below Starting Strength within 12" of this unit take a battle-shock test at -1.

enhancements.name: Oblivion Knight
enhancements.text: Anathema Psykana models only. +1 to Hit rolls for the bearer's unit. +1 to Wound rolls as well if the attack targets a Psyker or battle-shocked unit.

enhancements.name: Huntress' Eye
enhancements.text: Anathema Psykana models only. In your Movement phase, select a visible enemy unit within 12" of the bearer's unit. That unit takes a battle-shock test at -1.

stratagems.name: Anathema Blademastery
stratagems.when: Fight phase, when your unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.target: A Vigilator Squad unit of yours.
stratagems.effect: Choose Sustained Hits 1 or Lethal Hits. Your unit's attacks have that ability.

stratagems.name: Psy-Chaff Volley
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, just after your unit has shot.
stratagems.target: A Prosecutor Squad unit of yours.
stratagems.effect: Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. Until the end of the turn it is prosecuted: improve the AP of attacks that target it by 1.

stratagems.name: Purgation Sweep
stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when your unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.target: A Witchseeker Squad unit of yours.
stratagems.effect: +1 to Attacks for your unit's Torrent attacks. +2 instead against Psyker or battle-shocked units.
